item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure appeared to change across rounds: in round 1 the final card was the untapped card from the remaining pair; in round 2 it was the other initially tapped card after the second tap was discarded; and in rounds 3–10 it was the card tapped second."}
